A cone-shaped pile of salt is being depleted so that the volume of the pile decreases at $5\pi \,{\text{m}}^{3}/\text{hr}.$ The height of the pile is always one-half of its base diameter. Find the rate of the pile’s height decrease when the height is $5\,\text{m}.$ Do not round the answer.

*Hint*: Assume that the rate of decrease is positive.
